scenario.topic: Decide which interdisciplinary course the university should introduce

options.name: Data Science and Environmental Studies
options.upside: Equips students with skills to analyze environmental data for sustainability projects.
options.concern: Requires students to have foundational knowledge in both programming and ecology.

options.name: Psychology and Digital Media
options.upside: Explores human behavior in digital environments, useful for marketing and design careers.
options.concern: Limited technical media production skills taught in the course.

options.name: Urban Planning and Public Health

attrs.prerequisites: Intro to Urban Studies or Public Health

options.upside: Prepares students to design healthier urban environments addressing community needs.
options.concern: May require fieldwork that could be challenging for some students.

options.name: Business Ethics and Artificial Intelligence

attrs.prerequisites: Intro to Business, Basic AI Concepts

options.upside: Focuses on ethical decision-making in AI-driven business contexts.
options.concern: Conceptual content may be abstract without extensive technical AI background.
